groups.about: art.field lists every field an artist works in, main field first; a per-main-field question needs one field per artist (the main one), a who-works-in-sculpture question needs the whole list

G1a.question: For artists whose main field is sculpture, photography or illustration: how many artists per field, how many taught, and how many won at least one award?
G1a.natural: SELECT field, COUNT(*) AS artists, SUM(teaching) AS teachers, SUM(CASE WHEN awards >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS award_winners FROM art WHERE field IN ('Sculpture', 'Photography', 'Illustration') GROUP BY field;
G1a.key: SELECT field, COUNT(*) AS artists, SUM(teaching) AS teachers, SUM(CASE WHEN awards >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS award_winners FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN trim(CASE WHEN instr(field, '||') > 0 THEN substr(field, 1, instr(field, '||') - 1) ELSE field END) = 'Public Sculpture' THEN 'Sculpture' ELSE trim(CASE WHEN instr(field, '||') > 0 THEN substr(field, 1, instr(field, '||') - 1) ELSE field END) END AS field, teaching, awards FROM art) WHERE field IN ('Sculpture', 'Photography', 'Illustration') GROUP BY field;

G1b.question: Per birth continent with at least five such artists, how many artists work in sculpture (alone or alongside other fields), and how many of them taught?
G1b.natural: SELECT birth_continent, COUNT(*) AS sculptors, SUM(teaching) AS teachers FROM art WHERE field LIKE '%Sculpture%' AND birth_continent <> '' GROUP BY birth_continent HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5;
G1b.key: SELECT birth_continent, COUNT(*) AS sculptors, SUM(teaching) AS teachers FROM art WHERE field LIKE '%Sculpture%' AND birth_continent <> '' GROUP BY birth_continent HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5;

groups.about: art.genre lists every genre an artist works in, main genre first; a per-main-genre question needs one genre per artist in the description's vocabulary, a who-paints-both-portraits-and-landscapes question needs the whole list

G2a.question: For artists whose main genre is portrait, landscape or abstract: how many artists per genre, how many taught, and what share won at least one award?
G2a.natural: SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS artists, SUM(teaching) AS teachers, AVG(CASE WHEN awards >= 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS share_award_winners FROM art WHERE genre IN ('Portrait', 'Landscape', 'Abstract') GROUP BY genre;
G2a.key: SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS artists, SUM(teaching) AS teachers, AVG(CASE WHEN awards >= 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS share_award_winners FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN lower(trim(CASE WHEN instr(genre, '||') > 0 THEN substr(genre, 1, instr(genre, '||') - 1) ELSE genre END)) LIKE '%portrait%' THEN 'Portrait' WHEN lower(trim(CASE WHEN instr(genre, '||') > 0 THEN substr(genre, 1, instr(genre, '||') - 1) ELSE genre END)) LIKE '%landscape%' THEN 'Landscape' WHEN lower(trim(CASE WHEN instr(genre, '||') > 0 THEN substr(genre, 1, instr(genre, '||') - 1) ELSE genre END)) LIKE 'abstract%' OR lower(trim(CASE WHEN instr(genre, '||') > 0 THEN substr(genre, 1, instr(genre, '||') - 1) ELSE genre END)) = 'geometric abstraction' THEN 'Abstract' ELSE trim(CASE WHEN instr(genre, '||') > 0 THEN substr(genre, 1, instr(genre, '||') - 1) ELSE genre END) END AS genre, teaching, awards FROM art) WHERE genre IN ('Portrait', 'Landscape', 'Abstract') GROUP BY genre;

G2b.question: Per birth continent with at least five such artists, how many artists work in both portraits and landscapes, and how many of them taught?
G2b.natural: SELECT birth_continent, COUNT(*) AS artists, SUM(teaching) AS teachers FROM art WHERE genre LIKE '%Portrait%' AND genre LIKE '%Landscape%' AND birth_continent <> '' GROUP BY birth_continent HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5;
G2b.key: SELECT birth_continent, COUNT(*) AS artists, SUM(teaching) AS teachers FROM art WHERE genre LIKE '%Portrait%' AND genre LIKE '%Landscape%' AND birth_continent <> '' GROUP BY birth_continent HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5;

groups.about: art.art_movement lists every movement an artist took part in, main movement first; a per-main-movement question needs one movement per artist, a who-took-part-in question needs the whole list

G3a.question: For artists whose main movement is Surrealism, Abstract Expressionism or Pop Art: how many artists per movement, how many taught, and how many won at least one award?
G3a.natural: SELECT art_movement, COUNT(*) AS artists, SUM(teaching) AS teachers, SUM(CASE WHEN awards >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS award_winners FROM art WHERE art_movement IN ('Surrealism', 'Abstract Expressionism', 'Pop Art') GROUP BY art_movement;
G3a.key: SELECT art_movement, COUNT(*) AS artists, SUM(teaching) AS teachers, SUM(CASE WHEN awards >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS award_winners FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN lower(trim(CASE WHEN instr(art_movement, '||') > 0 THEN substr(art_movement, 1, instr(art_movement, '||') - 1) ELSE art_movement END)) LIKE '%surrealism%' THEN 'Surrealism' WHEN lower(trim(CASE WHEN instr(art_movement, '||') > 0 THEN substr(art_movement, 1, instr(art_movement, '||') - 1) ELSE art_movement END)) LIKE '%abstract expressionism%' THEN 'Abstract Expressionism' WHEN lower(trim(CASE WHEN instr(art_movement, '||') > 0 THEN substr(art_movement, 1, instr(art_movement, '||') - 1) ELSE art_movement END)) LIKE '%pop art%' THEN 'Pop Art' ELSE trim(CASE WHEN instr(art_movement, '||') > 0 THEN substr(art_movement, 1, instr(art_movement, '||') - 1) ELSE art_movement END) END AS art_movement, teaching, awards FROM art) WHERE art_movement IN ('Surrealism', 'Abstract Expressionism', 'Pop Art') GROUP BY art_movement;

G3b.question: For artists born in Europe and in North America, how many took part in Surrealism, in Pop Art and in Abstract Expressionism at any point in their career?
G3b.natural: SELECT birth_continent, SUM(CASE WHEN art_movement LIKE '%Surrealism%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS surrealism, SUM(CASE WHEN art_movement LIKE '%Pop Art%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pop_art, SUM(CASE WHEN art_movement LIKE '%Abstract Expressionism%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abstract_expressionism FROM art WHERE birth_continent IN ('Europe', 'North America') GROUP BY birth_continent;
G3b.key: SELECT birth_continent, SUM(CASE WHEN art_movement LIKE '%Surrealism%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS surrealism, SUM(CASE WHEN art_movement LIKE '%Pop Art%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pop_art, SUM(CASE WHEN art_movement LIKE '%Abstract Expressionism%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abstract_expressionism FROM art WHERE birth_continent IN ('Europe', 'North America') GROUP BY birth_continent;

groups.about: art.birth_date holds the full date of birth as stated ('1885/3/2'); a per-birth-year question that filters and groups on year numbers needs the year alone as a number, a question about birth dates of 1 January (a common stand-in for an unknown day) needs the full date

G13a.question: For each birth year from 1881 to 1890, how many artists were born that year, how many taught, and how many won at least one award?
G13a.natural: SELECT birth_date, COUNT(*) AS artists, SUM(teaching) AS teachers, SUM(CASE WHEN awards >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS award_winners FROM art WHERE birth_date BETWEEN 1881 AND 1890 GROUP BY birth_date;
G13a.key: SELECT birth_date, COUNT(*) AS artists, SUM(teaching) AS teachers, SUM(CASE WHEN awards >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS award_winners FROM (SELECT CAST(substr(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS birth_date, teaching, awards FROM art WHERE birth_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]/*') WHERE birth_date BETWEEN 1881 AND 1890 GROUP BY birth_date;

G13b.question: Per birth continent, how many artists have a birth date of 1 January (often a stand-in when only the year is known), and how many of them taught?
G13b.natural: SELECT birth_continent, COUNT(*) AS artists, SUM(teaching) AS teachers FROM art WHERE birth_date LIKE '%/1/1' AND birth_continent <> '' GROUP BY birth_continent;
G13b.key: SELECT birth_continent, COUNT(*) AS artists, SUM(teaching) AS teachers FROM art WHERE birth_date LIKE '%/1/1' AND birth_continent <> '' GROUP BY birth_continent;
